readings.pack (Claude): Jefferson 1949: “If the machine typewrites its answers, the cry may rise that it has learned to write” states that apparent capability is misleading evidence. Descartes describes performances rather than a test and holds two behavioural tests to be reliable; record him as context for C1.
readings.checker (Codex): Descartes 1637, qualified: responsive words and tasks done as well as or better than people are said not to show knowledge, which meets C1 for restricted probes; record that he endorses two broader tests. Under a narrower unrestricted-test reading, Jefferson 1949 heads C1 and Descartes is context.
